name: Ash Slinger
short_role: Obscure warning lines and turn uncertainty into early contact.
question: Can the keep preserve a redundant signal when sightlines fail?
telegraph: A gray smoke-ring marker announces obscured target detail and accelerated contact.
failure_mode: A single warning source loses the route and an exposed recon or morale defender is contacted early.
report_phrase: Smoke obscured the warning chain and accelerated contact.
